Name: Phantasmal Engine
Information:
**Phantasmal Engine**

This sentry-like elemental carries a fragment of raw thesite inside it, which it uses to observe and replicate supernatural phenomena around it. Specifically, it can generate the effects of spells it sees within a certain radius of itself, mimicking the magic of mortals to its own benefit. Though it is as predatory as other thesite elementals, a spark of natural curiosity resides within this elemental, which may goad a spellcaster into producing magical effects simply for a chance to experience recreating them.

Stat Blocks.title: Phantasmal Engine
languages: understands all Primordial languages but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Burst Adaptation
traits.description: The elemental cannot have disadvantage on attack rolls or saving throws, and will produce adaptations to anything that would cause these issues for as long as they are needed. If such a roll would have disadvantage, however, it cannot have advantage on it either.

traits.name: Magic Phantasm
traits.description:
If a non-thesite elemental creature within 60 feet of the elemental casts a spell, roll a d100. On a result equal to 10 × the spell’s level or higher, the elemental creates a copy of the spell (including the level it was cast at) and for the next hour can use the appropriate action to cast it (requiring no spell slot or components). Its spellcasting ability for these spells is Charisma (spell save DC 15, spell attack +7). After casting a copied spell, it is lost.

If the elemental is a target of the spell it is attempting to copy, roll the d100 twice and keep the higher result. Also, if two of these elementals are within range to copy the same spell, only the one who rolls the higher d100 result copies it.

actions.name: Bolt of Unraveling
actions.description: The elemental chooses three targets within 60 feet of it, who it strikes with a psychic blow concealed in a physical burst of energy. Each target must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5 (1d10) force damage and 5 (1d10) psychic damage on a failure.
